title: MAX-DESIGN decision catalog
description: Original, searchable design heuristics for AI coding agents. These are contextual starting points, not mandatory themes or imported upstream style catalogs.
guidance: Inspect the product and current codebase before selecting a direction. Match patterns to the user's task, available evidence, and constraints. See docs/decision-framework.md.

directions.title: Editorial clarity
directions.summary: Type-led layouts for content-rich products where comprehension and expertise matter.
fitWhen: Content is the main product value
Users need to scan, compare, or read deeply
layout: Use a controlled reading measure and visible heading hierarchy
Use grids only when they help comparison or browsing
directions.typography: Use a restrained type system with obvious heading and body roles; validate line length and text resizing.
directions.colorApproach: Use a deliberate neutral base and a small semantic accent; preserve readable contrast.
signature: Purposeful rules, indices, captions, or editorial alignment
avoid: Making every section a boxed card
Oversized headings that crowd actual content
risks: Long titles and translations may alter the composition
Thin or decorative type can fail at small sizes

directions.title: Calm enterprise
directions.summary: Predictable and trustworthy interfaces for complex workflows, settings, and business tools.
layout: Group by task and show related controls together
Make primary, secondary, and destructive actions visually distinct
directions.typography: Prioritize legible text, tabular numeric alignment where useful, and stable hierarchy.
directions.colorApproach: Use semantic roles for surfaces, text, borders, focus, and status instead of using brand color everywhere.
signature: Quiet but explicit status and focus treatment
avoid: Generic grey cards with no information hierarchy
risks: Dense tables require responsive and zoom testing

directions.title: Technical instrument
directions.summary: Information-dense interfaces for monitoring, developer tools, and analytical work.
fitWhen: Users monitor changing values or investigate anomalies
High information density is useful to the target audience
layout: Prioritize changes, thresholds, and actionable anomalies
Use persistent metric names, units, filters, and freshness indicators
directions.typography: Favor high legibility and stable numeral treatment; never shrink labels simply to fit more cards.
directions.colorApproach: Reserve vivid status colors for consistent meanings and pair them with text or icons.
avoid: Neon decoration unrelated to a state
Charts without definitions, ranges, or source context
risks: Dense views can overwhelm novice users
Streaming data and large tables may hurt performance

directions.title: Warm guidance
directions.summary: Supportive product flows for onboarding, setup, learning, and help-oriented tasks.
fitWhen: Users are new to the product or task
layout: Break the task into understandable chunks
Show helpful next steps and preserve context across steps
directions.typography: Use direct labels, clear instructions, and comfortable body text.
directions.colorApproach: Use restrained warmth as a supporting tone; retain strong contrast and clear status roles.
signature: Progress that represents real steps or actual work
avoid: Cheerful copy that hides errors or consequences
risks: Long steps create scroll burden on mobile
Progress indicators can mislead if work is not linear

directions.title: Expressive brand
directions.summary: Memorable visual systems for creative, cultural, or consumer brands where identity is part of the value.
fitWhen: Brand expression is an explicit product goal
The audience and task can support a distinctive composition
layout: Select one focal point and let supporting content recede
Use contrast, scale, or asymmetry intentionally
directions.typography: Use expressive display type only when body copy remains highly readable.
directions.colorApproach: Choose a small, intentional palette with semantic status and accessible interaction states.
signature: A product-specific composition or art direction
avoid: Animation or contrast that competes with primary actions
risks: Large type and asymmetry can fail at narrow widths
Brand colors may fail contrast for controls or text

directions.title: Commerce confidence
directions.summary: Product discovery and purchase flows that help people evaluate choices and understand cost, availability, and next steps.
fitWhen: Users browse, compare, select, or buy items
Transparent details and predictable next steps build trust
layout: Make product identity, price, availability, and relevant differences easy to scan
Keep filters and selected options visible and reversible
directions.typography: Keep prices, quantities, units, and option labels unambiguous.
directions.colorApproach: Use clear selection and availability states; never rely on color alone.
signature: Clear selected, unavailable, and confirmation states
avoid: Invented reviews, urgency, scarcity, or social proof
Surprise fees or hidden selection state
risks: Variant and price data must remain consistent across states

pagePatterns.title: SaaS landing page
pagePatterns.summary: Explain value quickly, establish credible proof, show how the product works, then present a clear next action.
pagePatterns.question: Who is this for, what outcome does it create, and why should the visitor believe it?
priorities: Product evidence or a real use-case demonstration
One clear primary CTA with a predictable destination
Important objections, limits, or pricing context where relevant
states: Consent or preference state if present
antiPatterns: Generic claims like best-in-class with no evidence
Repeated feature cards with indistinguishable hierarchy

pagePatterns.title: Analytics dashboard
pagePatterns.summary: Turn measurements into a decision rather than presenting a wall of equally weighted cards.
pagePatterns.question: What changed, compared with what, and what should the user do next?
priorities: Metric definitions, units, and time range
A hierarchy that distinguishes critical signals from context
Chart choice matched to the decision
states: No data and no filter matches
antiPatterns: Decorative charts with no decision value

pagePatterns.title: Data management table
pagePatterns.summary: Help users find, compare, and act on records while preserving context and preventing accidental changes.
pagePatterns.question: How does a person find the right record and understand the effect of an action?
priorities: Clear column labels and meaningful sort behavior
Search, filters, and active filter summary
antiPatterns: Tiny text instead of adapting the layout

pagePatterns.title: Settings and admin
pagePatterns.summary: Make configuration discoverable, changes understandable, and destructive operations safe.
pagePatterns.question: Can users locate a setting, understand its current value, and safely change it?
antiPatterns: Destructive reset beside routine controls without distinction

pagePatterns.title: Form and onboarding flow
pagePatterns.summary: Help users submit accurate information with minimal unnecessary effort and recoverable errors.
pagePatterns.question: What is the minimum necessary data, and how can a user correct mistakes without losing work?
priorities: Clear validation timing and correction guidance
antiPatterns: Fake success when no submission succeeded

pagePatterns.title: Search and empty states
pagePatterns.summary: Help users recover when content is absent, a filter is too narrow, or a search query has no match.
pagePatterns.question: Why is there no content, and what is the next useful action?
priorities: Distinguish genuinely empty from filter mismatch
Offer relevant reset, retry, or create action
antiPatterns: Same empty message for every cause
Fake content presented as live results

interactionPatterns.title: Asynchronous save
interactionPatterns.summary: Communicate pending and confirmed save state without implying success prematurely.
behavior: Show pending feedback on the affected control or region
Prevent duplicate submission if it would create harmful duplicate work
Confirm success only after the system confirms it
On failure, preserve safe input and explain retry or correction

interactionPatterns.title: Destructive action guard
interactionPatterns.summary: Make irreversible consequences clear without adding pointless confirmation friction to routine work.
behavior: Use an explicit verb naming the target or consequence
Keep destructive and routine actions visually distinct
Require confirmation when risk justifies it; provide undo when feasible
Explain what cannot be restored

interactionPatterns.title: Filter and search state
interactionPatterns.summary: Keep search, active filters, result counts, and empty states synchronized and recoverable.
behavior: Represent active filters so users can review and remove them
Preserve query when details or pagination are revisited when appropriate
Debounce only where it improves behavior and expose loading state when delay matters
Differentiate no data from no matches

interactionPatterns.title: Dialog and overlay
interactionPatterns.summary: Keep modal context, keyboard focus, and dismissal behavior predictable.
behavior: Give the dialog a programmatic name
Move focus in and return focus logically on close
Support Escape for dismissible dialogs and make dismissal rules clear
Prevent background interaction only when the dialog is truly modal

interactionPatterns.title: Meaningful loading and empty states
interactionPatterns.summary: Show accurate status and a helpful next step without fabricating progress or results.
behavior: Use skeletons when they reduce perceived structural shift, not as decoration
Use determinate progress only when progress can be measured
Explain what is missing and the next useful action in an empty state
Distinguish stale, partial, and failed data when the difference matters

densityProfiles.title: Spacious
densityProfiles.summary: Emphasize focus and readability for low-density tasks and content-led pages.
useWhen: Few high-value actions or content elements
Users need to read or decide without distraction
layoutRules: Use a clear content width and visible grouping
cautions: Do not waste space on operational screens where comparison matters

densityProfiles.title: Balanced
densityProfiles.summary: Support mixed content, actions, and context without overwhelming the page.
useWhen: A page combines summary and a handful of actions
A broad audience needs scanability and breathing room
layoutRules: Group related details and collapse only secondary complexity
cautions: Avoid applying the same card grid to every section

densityProfiles.title: Compact
densityProfiles.summary: Support expert workflows and high-volume information while retaining legible controls.
useWhen: Users compare many records or act repeatedly
Information density is a real task requirement
layoutRules: Use clear alignment and stable labels
Preserve sorting, focus, spacing, and status meaning
cautions: Do not shrink text and targets as the only means of fitting more content
